mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because the result explains how sensory feedback can help coordinate movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate pathway fittings felt repetitive: each confirmed a placement without adding much explanation.

surprise.text: The explanation that muscle stretch contributes to the sense of limb position clarified why the stretch pathway matters.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the order of the three pathway fittings seemed arbitrary.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the arm connects to other body systems, though I would hope for fewer repetitive fittings and more concrete examples.
